title: Discharge against medical advice
stem: Cubicle 7. Mr Chan, 45, came in with 3 hours of central chest pain. His first troponin is mildly raised and the ECG shows new T-wave inversion in V1–V4. He wants to leave to go back to work. Talk to him.

phases.title: Explore
phases.goal: Why he wants to go, the risks, capacity, and alternatives.

notes:
Checked against the GMC and Hong Kong Medical Council guidance on consent and capacity, the Hospital Authority DAMA policy, and ESC 2023 ACS guidelines.

Capacity is decision-specific and presumed in adults. A person has capacity if they can understand, retain, use and weigh the relevant information, and communicate a decision. An unwise decision is not proof of incapacity. If capacitous, a patient may refuse treatment; the doctor's job is to explore the reasons (fear, money, childcare, work), negotiate alternatives, explain risks clearly, document, and leave the door open (safety-net, medication, follow-up, a written summary). The DAMA form documents the discussion; refusing to sign it does not stop him leaving and must not delay care.

If he lacked capacity (for example from hypoxia, intoxication or delirium), treatment in his best interests (and common-law necessity) applies. Hong Kong's Mental Health Ordinance is for mental disorder, not for chest pain.

NSTEMI with dynamic ECG changes needs admission, antiplatelets, anticoagulation and early angiography (within 24 hours for high risk).

Your notes list DAMA as a topic without detail.

steps.label: Talk to Mr Chan
steps.hint: Explore why; explain risk; assess capacity; negotiate.

turns.line: I'm fine now, doc. I've got a big contract to sign tonight. I'm going.
turns.lz: 醫生，我而家冇事喇。今晚我要簽份大合約。我要走。

opts.t: I can see this contract matters a lot. Can you tell me more about what's worrying you about staying?
opts.tz: 我見到呢份合約對你好重要。你可唔可以講多啲，留喺醫院你最擔心啲咩？
opts.rz: 如果我錯過咗，盤生意就冇喇。成家人靠我㗎。
opts.r: If I miss it, I lose the business. My family depends on it.

turns.line: If I miss it, I lose the business. My family depends on it.
turns.lz: 如果我錯過咗，盤生意就冇喇。成家人靠我㗎。

opts.t: Your blood test and ECG show strain on the heart muscle — a type of heart attack. The risk is that it could get worse suddenly in the next few days, including a dangerous heart rhythm or death. Treatment in hospital lowers that risk a lot.
opts.tz: 你驗血同心電圖顯示心肌受壓——係一種心臟病發。危險在於呢幾日可能突然惡化，包括危險嘅心律不正，甚至死亡。留喺醫院治療可以大大減低呢個風險。
opts.rz: 心臟病發？但係已經唔痛喇……
opts.r: A heart attack? But the pain's gone…
opts.mark: Explains the diagnosis and specific risks in plain language

opts.t: Your troponin is up and there's TWI in the anterior leads.
opts.tz: 你嘅 troponin 升咗，anterior leads 有 TWI。
opts.r: I don't know what that means. I'm going.

turns.line: A heart attack? But the pain's gone…
turns.lz: 心臟病發？但係已經唔痛喇……

opts.t: Can you tell me in your own words what could happen if you go home?
opts.tz: 你可唔可以用自己嘅說話講吓，如果你返屋企可能會發生咩事？
opts.rz: 可能會差咗……可能會心臟病發得更犀利，甚至會死。
opts.r: It could get worse… I could have a bigger heart attack or even die.
opts.mark: Checks understanding and ability to weigh information (capacity)

turns.line: Isn't there another way? Can my partner sign for me?
turns.lz: 仲有冇其他方法？可唔可以叫我拍檔幫我簽？

opts.t: Could your partner or lawyer sign tonight, or could we arrange a video call from the ward? Our social worker can help with the letter to your client.
opts.tz: 可唔可以叫你拍檔或者律師今晚幫你簽，或者我哋喺病房安排視像會議？我哋嘅社工可以幫你寫信俾你嘅客。
opts.rz: ……咁我拍檔可以去嘅。好，我留低。
opts.r: …I suppose my partner could go. OK, I'll stay.

opts.t: No. Your choice: stay or go.
opts.tz: 唔得。你自己揀：留低定走。

steps.ask: Thank you. If he still insisted on leaving, what would you do?
steps.label: Examiner: if he still insisted on leaving?
steps.hint: Capacitous refusal: respect it, reduce harm, document, open door.

opts.t: He has capacity: respect his decision, but keep trying to persuade
Harm reduction: aspirin, GTN spray, written summary, cardiology clinic, return immediately with pain
Document capacity, the risks explained, alternatives offered, and his words; DAMA form (not required to sign)
Tell him he can never come back if he leaves
Detain him under the Mental Health Ordinance
opts.r: He has no mental disorder and has capacity. Detention would be unlawful.

wrong: Agreement with the treating doctor's advice
Orientation to time, place and person, and memory

qs.q: Is an unwise decision evidence of incapacity?
wrong: Yes, if it risks his life

qs.q: Refusing to sign the DAMA form means…
qs.a: He can still leave; document the refusal
wrong: He must stay in the department until he signs
All treatment stops immediately, including analgesia

qs.q: Management of NSTEMI with dynamic ECG changes?
When can you treat without consent?
wrong: When they disagree with you about the risks involved
When the family consents for a capacitous adult

badge.name: Door Open
badge.flavor: Ask why, explain risk, test capacity, negotiate, document.

cards.q: Adults are presumed to have capacity until…
options: They disagree with the doctor's advice or plan
A psychiatrist has examined and signed a form

cards.q: Which is part of assessing capacity?
options: Do they agree with the plan we have suggested?
Are they educated to university level?

cards.q: A capacitous patient wants to leave with an NSTEMI. You…
options: Restrain him until the troponin is back
Call the police to stop him leaving
Discharge him without advice or letter

cards.q: Early invasive angiography for high-risk NSTEMI (ESC 2023)?
cards.why: Immediate (<2 h) if very high risk.

cards.q: The Mental Health Ordinance can be used to detain…
options: People with a mental disorder meeting its criteria
cards.why: Not for physical illness in a capacitous adult.
